entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's completely useless to me.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please? And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item?

The issue? The issue is that your sizing is a joke! I ordered a large jersey, and this thing is so tight I can barely breathe. It's the wrong size, simple as that. I don't have time for this, just process the return. The name is Alex Foster, order number 788-01B.
Okay, thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered 13 days ago. So the fit is just too tight for comfort?

Are you listening to me? Yes, it's too tight! I want to exchange it or get my money back. This is unacceptable. If you don't fix this right now, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Do you want me to speak to your manager?
That won't be necessary, Alex. I can absolutely handle this for you. I'm just confirming our policy. One moment.

Alright, I've checked everything. The jersey is considered a standard apparel item, which falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that timeframe, processing a return is no problem at all.
Oh. So you can do it then?

Yes, absolutely. We can either process a full refund once we receive the item, or I can help you start an exchange for a different size right now. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a larger size?
Okay... good. Let's do an exchange then. I guess I'll try an extra-large. The quality seemed fine, it was just the wrong size.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange order for you and emailed you a pre-paid return label for the original jersey. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once the return is scanned, we'll ship out the new size. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
